title: Claude Accounts — run multiple Claude desktop apps side by side
excerpt: One window per Claude account. Log in once, it sticks forever. macOS & Windows. $14 one-time.
content_html:
macOS + Windows · One-time $14

Work Claude, personal Claude, a client's Claude — juggling them by logging in and out is misery. Claude Accounts opens one Claude desktop app per account — each logged in once, forever. Works with SSO work accounts (Okta, Microsoft, Google) on macOS and Windows. No logging out. No Terminal. Just click.

Instant download for macOS & Windows · one-time payment · secure checkout by Stripe

Claude Accounts

One window per account · all running side by side

How it works

Three clicks. Logged in forever.

Claude Accounts launches extra, fully isolated copies of the official Claude desktop app — one per account. Nothing about your normal Claude changes.

STEP 01

Open Claude Accounts

A clean picker shows your main Claude plus every account you've added.

STEP 02

Add an account, name it

Type a name — “work”, “studio”, anything. A fresh Claude window opens and asks you to log in. Once.

STEP 03

Use them all at once

Every account stays logged in permanently and opens side by side. Re-opening one just focuses its window.

Why people grab it

Small tool. Big unlock.

🪟

One window per account

Work, personal, team, client — each account is its own real Claude desktop app.

🔐

Logins that stick

Each account logs in once and stays logged in. No more sign-out / sign-in roulette.

🏢

SSO work accounts

Company sign-in (Okta, Microsoft, Google SSO) comes back to the right account window — nothing to set up. Native on macOS; on Windows since v2.6, marked beta while real-world reports come in.

🧱

Fully isolated

Separate settings, history, connectors and data folders. Accounts never touch each other — or your main app.

🖱️

A real native app

A premium native macOS app (running indicators, rename/remove, drag-to-install DMG) and a double-clickable launcher on Windows.

💻

macOS & Windows

Both included in one purchase, same simple picker on each.

📜

Source included

The complete Swift + PowerShell source ships inside the download — read every line in any text editor. No telemetry; the only network call is a once-a-day check of a static version file so the app can tell you a free update exists.

Install in 60 seconds

Two steps — then you're set.

The Mac app is signed with our Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens like any other app — no security hoops.

macOS

Drag and open

1. Drag Claude Accounts into Applications.
2. Double-click it. It opens — signed & notarized by Apple.
Then "+ Add account", name it, log in once. Done.
Needs macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer, Apple Silicon and Intel, and the official Claude desktop app already installed.

⊞ Windows

Unzip and run

1. Unzip anywhere (e.g. Documents).
2. Double-click "Claude Accounts.bat" — pure cmd, no PowerShell, so it runs even on locked-down work PCs.
If SmartScreen warns: More info → Run anyway.
There's also an optional "Claude Accounts (graphical).bat" pop-up picker, which does need PowerShell. Both are plain text — read every line in Notepad if you like — and both need the official Claude desktop app already installed.

FAQ

Quick answers

Is this an official Anthropic product?

No. Claude Accounts is an independent utility made by DeckSpace. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. It simply launches the official Claude desktop app you already installed, with an isolated data folder per account.

Do I need multiple Claude subscriptions?

You need your own Claude account for each profile you add (free or paid — that's between you and Anthropic). Claude Accounts doesn't create accounts, share logins, or change any limits; it just lets each of your accounts have its own window.

Will this get my Claude account banned?

No. Owning more than one Claude account — say a work one and a personal one — is allowed; what Anthropic's terms prohibit is sharing a single login between people or trying to evade usage limits. Claude Accounts does neither. It simply opens the official Claude desktop app you already installed, pointed at a separate data folder per account you legitimately own (the same way browsers run separate profiles). It never automates Claude, intercepts its traffic, shares credentials, or touches any limit — so there's nothing for it to flag. You remain responsible for following Anthropic's terms on each account.

Does it modify the Claude app?

No. It never touches the Claude app or your existing data. Each added account lives in its own folder (ClaudeAccounts/<name>) and launches the official app pointed at that folder. Delete the folder and the account profile is gone.

macOS says it can't verify the app — what do I do?

Current downloads are signed with our Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so this warning no longer appears. If you have an older copy, re-download with your purchase email — the newest build is free. (On an old copy: right-click the app → Open → Open works too.) Questions? info@deckspace.dev.

How does the Windows version work?

Two double-clickable launchers in one zip. Start with "Claude Accounts.bat" — a plain-text menu that uses no PowerShell at all, so it runs even on locked-down work PCs. "Claude Accounts (graphical).bat" is an optional dark pop-up picker that does need PowerShell. Both are plain text — open them in Notepad and read every line before running them.

Does it work with SSO / enterprise work accounts?

On macOS, yes. The app runs company sign-in (Okta, Microsoft, Google Workspace) through macOS's own native secure sign-in window, and the result is delivered straight back to the account window that asked for it — nothing to configure.

On Windows, company sign-in, Google and email-link sign-in now reach the right account window too — v2.6 adds this and it's in the current download. It's marked beta while reports from real corporate identity providers come in. Updates are free — re-download from your receipt link any time. If SSO on Windows is the reason you're buying, email us first; there's also a 7-day no-questions refund.

What about updates or refunds?

Launcher updates are free — re-download anytime from your receipt link, and the Mac app quietly shows a small "update available" row when a new version is out. Not for you? Reply to your Stripe receipt or email info@deckspace.dev within 7 days for a full refund. Details in the refund policy.

Does the app phone home?

One request only: once a day the Mac app fetches a static version file from deckspace.dev so it can tell you a free update exists. No query parameters, no identifiers, no telemetry — nothing about you or your accounts is ever sent. The complete source ships in your download, so you can verify this yourself.

Lost your download link?

No problem — enter the email you paid with and we'll send your personal re-download link. It always serves the latest version, free.

Claude™ is a trademark of Anthropic, PBC. Claude Accounts is an unofficial utility and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic. It manages separate accounts you legitimately own — it is not a way around any Anthropic usage limit, and you are responsible for complying with Anthropic's terms for each of your accounts. The launcher uses a standard application flag (--user-data-dir) and may require an update if the Claude desktop app changes; updates are free.

Guides

Learn more

FAQ

快速解答

Is this an official Anthropic product?

不会。Claude Accounts 是 DeckSpace 制作的独立实用程序。 它不隶属于 Anthropic，也不受 Anthropic 认可。 它只是启动您已经安装的官方克劳德桌面应用程序，每个帐户都有一个独立的数据文件夹。

Do I need multiple Claude subscriptions?

您添加的每个个人资料都需要您自己的 Claude 帐户（免费或付费 - 这是您和 Anthropic 之间的事情）。 Claude Accounts 不会创建帐户、共享登录信息或更改任何限制；它只是让您的每个帐户都有自己的窗口。

Will this get my Claude account banned?

不可以。拥有多个 Claude 帐户（例如工作帐户和个人帐户）是允许的； Anthropic 的条款禁止的是在人们之间共享单一登录或试图逃避使用限制。 克劳德·阿克斯（Claude Accounts）两者都不做。 它只是打开您已经安装的官方克劳德桌面应用程序，指向您合法拥有的每个帐户的单独数据文件夹（与浏览器运行单独配置文件的方式相同）。 它永远不会使 Claude 自动化、拦截其流量、共享凭证或触及任何限制 - 因此它没有任何需要标记的内容。 您仍有责任遵守每个帐户的 Anthropic 条款。

Does it modify the Claude app?

不会。它永远不会触及 Claude 应用程序或您现有的数据。 每个添加的帐户都位于其自己的文件夹中 (ClaudeAccounts/<name>)，并启动指向该文件夹的官方应用程序。 删除该文件夹，帐户配置文件就会消失。

macOS says it can't verify the app — what do I do?

当前的下载已使用我们的 Apple 开发者 ID 进行签名并经过 Apple 公证，因此不再出现此警告。 如果您有旧版本，请使用购买电子邮件重新下载 - 最新版本是免费的。 （在旧副本上：右键单击应用程序→打开→打开也可以。） 问题？ info@deckspace.dev.

How does the Windows version work?

两个可双击的启动器位于一个拉链中。 从“Claude Accounts.bat”开始——一个完全不使用 PowerShell 的纯文本菜单，因此它甚至可以在锁定的工作 PC 上运行。 “Claude Accounts（图形）.bat”是一个可选的深色弹出选择器，确实需要 PowerShell。 两者都是纯文本 - 在记事本中打开它们并在运行它们之前阅读每一行。

Does it work with SSO / enterprise work accounts?

在 macOS 上，是的。 该应用程序通过 macOS 自己的本机安全登录窗口运行公司登录（Okta、Microsoft、Google Workspace），结果会直接传送回要求的帐户窗口 - 无需配置。

在 Windows 上，公司登录、Google 和电子邮件链接登录现在也可以到达正确的帐户窗口 - v2.6 添加了此功能，并且位于当前的下载中。 当来自真实企业身份提供商的报告出现时，它被标记为测试版。 更新是免费的——随时从您的收据链接重新下载。 如果 Windows 上的 SSO 是您购买的原因，请先给我们发送电子邮件；还有 7 天无条件退款。

仅一个请求：Mac 应用程序每天一次从 Deckspace.dev 获取静态版本文件，以便它可以告诉您存在免费更新。 没有查询参数、没有标识符、没有遥测——任何有关您或您帐户的信息都不会被发送。 完整的源代码包含在您的下载中，因此您可以自行验证。
